name: Steam Courier
summary: The Bequest's fuel: he strikes, delivers and passes beyond, alive.

face.name: Steam Courier

keyword.name: Surge
keyword.rules: he may attack the very turn he enters the field

face.flavor: He arrives before word of his arrival.

relay.text: If he attacked this turn, you may retire him to the Requiem Zone, even if he entered the field this turn.
